title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
title_zh: Intern Lumina U2：一种用于全视觉理解与图像生成的多码本扩散大语言模型

paragraphs.en: Intern Lumina U2是一种用于全视觉理解与图像生成的多码本扩散大语言模型。 Unified multimodal generation covers discrete, continuous, and hybrid paradigms. Discrete approaches with single-codebook visual tokenizers align naturally with text modeling but have limited representational capacity. Continuous and hybrid approaches retain richer visual representations, but they model text and images in heterogeneous spaces with different training objectives, potentially introducing optimization conflicts between modalities with misaligned representation spaces. These choices expose a central question: how to efficiently model high-capacity visual representations alongside textual content in a shared optimization space within a single backbone. We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling. At the input, the embeddings are concatenated at each position; at the output, a lightweight multi-codebook autoregressive head predicts the codes within each position sequentially, while the diffusion backbone processes all positions in parallel. Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model. We also improve the inference efficiency through a stability-aware sampling strategy, which combines confidence-plateau-guided unmasking approach with drift-triggered cache refreshing mechanisms, accelerating image generation by 4.45x.
paragraphs.zh: Intern Lumina U2 是一种面向全视觉理解与图像生成的多码本扩散大语言模型。统一的多模态生成涵盖离散、连续以及混合范式。 采用单码本视觉分词器的离散方法与文本建模天然契合，但表示能力有限。 连续与混合方法保留了更丰富的视觉表示，但它们在异构空间中以不同的训练目标对文本和图像进行建模，可能因表示空间未对齐而在模态之间引入优化冲突。 这些选择引出了一个核心问题：如何在单一骨干网络的共享优化空间中，高效地对高容量视觉表示与文本内容进行建模。 我们提出 Intern Lumina U2，据我们所知，这是首个在完全离散空间中表示多码本视觉 token 的扩散语言模型。 每个视觉位置由来自互补码本的一组编码表示，在保持与离散文本建模兼容的同时提升了表示容量。 在输入端，各位置的嵌入被拼接在一起；在输出端，一个轻量级的多码本自回归头按顺序预测每个位置内的编码，而扩散骨干网络则并行处理所有位置。 基于 AToken 的统一 4D 表示，Intern Lumina U2 在单一骨干网络中支持图像、视频和 3D 输入，并在视觉理解、图像生成和图像编辑方面取得了统一模型中的领先性能。 我们进一步在昇腾和 NVIDIA 平台上构建了覆盖训练、推理与评估的全栈系统，以验证模型的跨平台有效性。 我们还通过一种稳定性感知采样策略提升推理效率，该策略将置信度平台期引导的解掩码方法与漂移触发的缓存刷新机制相结合，将图像生成加速了 4.45 倍。
